title: Pork Kebabs with Ukrainian Flair
description: A twist on traditional pork kebabs, this recipe incorporates Ukrainian flavors and spices for a unique twist. Perfect for a summer evening or outdoor gathering.

ingredients.name: juicy red bell pepper, cut into 1-inch pieces
zesty yellow onion, cut into 1-inch pieces

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together lemon juice, olive oil, salt, black pepper, and garlic.
Add the pork cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the pork and vegetables onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the pork is cooked through.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
Serve with a side of Ukrainian-style bread for a complete meal.
